attributes.description: Alerts when the site-wide p75 Time to First Byte (TTFB) exceeds the 'poor' threshold (1800ms) over a 1-hour window. TTFB reflects edge/server responsiveness and directly drives LCP, so a sustained elevation is an early signal of cold starts or edge congestion before it fully manifests as an LCP regression.
attributes.name: [Vercel OTel] Elevated TTFB p75 (edge/server latency)

investigation_guide.blob:
## Elevated TTFB p75

### Triage Steps
1. TTFB measures the time from navigation start to the first byte of the response — elevation here points to backend/edge responsiveness rather than client-side rendering.
2. Check for cold-start patterns: a spike right after a new deployment often means lambda cold starts are dominating; this should resolve as the deployment warms up.
3. Check the Logs data stream for elevated latency or errors around the same time window, broken down by `vercel.execution.region` — regional edge congestion or an overloaded lambda pool would explain a broad TTFB elevation.
4. Segment by geography (`geo.country.iso_code`) in the Speed Insights dashboard to see if the elevation is global or localized to users served by a specific edge region.
5. If TTFB is elevated but LCP/INP look fine, this may be an early warning — investigate before it becomes user-visible.

### Escalation
If TTFB p75 remains above the poor threshold for more than one hour, or if it is trending upward alongside the regional error-rate-skew rule, escalate to the on-call engineer to investigate edge/lambda capacity.

esqlQuery.esql:
TS metrics-vercel.speedinsights.v1.otel-default
| WHERE deployment.environment.name == "production"
    AND metrics.TTFB IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    ttfb_p75 = PERCENTILE(metrics.TTFB, 75),
    samples = COUNT(metrics.TTFB)
// Minimum sample size, since Speed Insights data is sampled
| WHERE samples >= 20
// "Poor" threshold per the Web Vitals spec table (milliseconds); lower toward 800-1800 for a stricter,
// earlier-warning threshold aligned with the "needs improvement" boundary
| WHERE ttfb_p75 > 1800.0
